supersedes: CORPUS-FROZEN-V2; the 47-study roster is unchanged, while the disagreement interpretation and symmetric unresolved counts are corrected

IN_SCOPE_NOT_PEER_REVIEWED.reason: In scope, but no peer-reviewed record was found. CONTEXTUAL under the frozen rule, never confirmatory.

RESERVE_split.reason: Set aside by the precision layer inside the two judgeable buckets before the main screen. A separate seeded audit of 100 records found four in scope and no peer-reviewed record; this is not a population-completeness estimate.

UNRESOLVED.reason: Not adjudicated. There are 237 unresolved rows before title deduplication. Most are records at least one axis called UNCERTAIN, and 239 of the 929 judged records had no abstract retrieved. Fifteen records in the audited comparison set received different axis labels. These are unresolved, not judged and rejected.

what_this_is: In scope on both model axes, with a peer-reviewed record established from metadata or recovered by sibling resolution. Independence applies only to the 58-row blinded comparison batch; 19 sibling-promoted rows were double-judged but not blinded. It is a floor, not a census.
